title: Loop Counter Unchanged in While
code:
items = [1, 2, 3]
i = 0
while i < len(items):
    print(items[i])

bugs.explanation: `i` is never incremented, so `i < len(items)` is always `True` and the loop runs forever. Add `i += 1` inside the loop body to advance the index.

title: Loop Variable Reuse
Infinite Loop Typo
code:
count = 0
while count < 5:
    print(count)
    count = count - 1

bugs.explanation: `count - 1` decrements `count`, moving it away from `5` rather than toward it. The loop runs infinitely. Use `count += 1` to increment toward the termination condition.
